name: Generate Eccentricity Parcellations from Visual ROIs
summary: Combines eccentricity-binned visual ROIs for one eccentricity range (min_degree to max_degree) into a single volumetric parcellation, optionally adding the LGN and optic chiasm ROIs, using AFNI.
description: Takes the ROIs produced by the eccentricity ROI Apps (files named *.Ecc<min>to<max>.nii.gz), selects those matching one eccentricity range and merges them with AFNI 3dTcat/3dTstat into a parcellation with key.txt and label.json. The FreeSurfer input provides the <inputparc>+aseg volume used as the reference grid. Use it after one of the 'Generate Visual Regions of Interest Binned by Eccentricity' Apps; min_degree and max_degree must match a bin that exists in the ROI directory.

inputs.description: Directory of eccentricity-binned visual ROIs (files named *.Ecc<min>to<max>.nii.gz), optionally including LGN and optic-chiasm ROIs.
FreeSurfer output used to create the <inputparc>+aseg volume that defines the output grid.

outputs.description: Volumetric parcellation of the visual ROIs in the selected eccentricity range, with key.txt and label.json.

parameters.description: Minimum eccentricity degree for parcellation. Can only be one value
Maximum eccentricity degree for parcellation. Can only be one value
FreeSurfer parcellation whose +aseg volume is converted to NIfTI and used as the reference grid for the output parcellation.
If true, add the LGN ROIs (*lgn*.nii.gz) from the input ROI directory to the parcellation.
If true, add the optic chiasm ROI (*optic-chiasm.nii.gz) from the input ROI directory to the parcellation.

failure_modes.cause: parc/parc.nii.gz was not created, usually because no ROI matched the requested eccentricity range.
failure_modes.fix: Set min_degree/max_degree to a bin present in the input ROIs.
